description: For the always-false relation, bounded search returns the bound, including bound zero, while unbounded search is undefined.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PartialRecursiveFunctions.always_false_search (b : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.boundedPredicateSearch (fun x => False) List.Vector.nil b = b ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.predicateSearch (fun x => False) List.Vector.nil = Part.none
